name: StripForge
description: Stripboard (Veroboard) layout: strip copper, cuts and wire links in a normal .kicad_pcb, KiCad DRC, and a printable build sheet.

actions.name: StripForge: Analyze
actions.description: Snap the parts to the stripboard grid and report cuts, links needed, slot jobs and placement hints (read-only)

actions.name: StripForge: Build strips
actions.description: Save the board, make a save point (a zip in stripforge/<Project>-stripforge-backups), write the strip copper, cuts, holes and W link footprints into it, and reload it

actions.name: StripForge: Add links to schematic
actions.description: Add a StripForge:Link symbol (with its footprint, schematic path and net labels) to the project's schematic for every W link footprint placed on the board; a save point of the changed sheets is made first

actions.name: StripForge: Run DRC
actions.description: Run KiCad's DRC (kicad-cli) on the built board and sort real problems from expected stripboard noise

actions.name: StripForge: Build sheet
actions.description: Write the printable build sheet (mirrored copper side, checklists, net check) for the built board and open it in a browser

actions.name: StripForge: Restore last
actions.description: Load the last save point: remove StripForge's work since then (built board, link files, schematic link edits) and reload the board, so you respawn right where you left off
